packageRules.description: CryptPad publishes its releases as `version-X.Y.Z` Docker tags, next to unrelated `latest` and `opendesk-*` ones. `cryptpad_version` holds the bare `X.Y.Z` part (`cryptpad_container_image_tag` re-adds the `version-` prefix), so `extractVersion` strips the prefix off the tags before they get compared against it and written back. The regex versioning then only admits pure `X.Y.Z` tags, which discards `latest` and `opendesk-*`.
